# Derik Bannister — derikbannister.com

> Operator and founder based in Oregon. Builds websites, local SEO, answer engine
> optimization (AEO), Google Ads and Local Services Ads, AI phone answering, CRM and
> follow-up automation, reputation systems, and custom software for service businesses
> across Oregon, Washington, California, Idaho, and Nevada — 212 markets and 54 trades.
> Flat pricing quoted up front; the client owns the domain, code, content, and data.
> Contact: bannisterderik@gmail.com · call/text 530-736-7085.

## Flat-price products
- [250+ page website build](https://derikbannister.com/start/): $999 invoiced, $500 at checkout. 7 business days. Client owns the source code.
- [Claude Code setup](https://derikbannister.com/claude-code/): $1,500 flat. Claude Code installed, existing tools connected, business configuration written, 3–5 custom skills built, 60-minute working session. 5 business days. Client owns the configuration and skills.
